summary: rest-proxy is a Kubernetes component. connecting to external services: grpc. with 46 operator config constants (18 env vars). references components: kserve (import).
repository_description: This REST Proxy leverages gRPC-Gateway to create a reverse-proxy server which translates a RESTful HTTP API into gRPC. This allows sending inference requests using the KServe V2 REST Predict Protocol to platforms that expect the gRPC V2 Predict Protocol.
